ai_review.summary: Excellent Spring‑1990 performance captured on a crisp FM broadcast.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the show, noting that the band was "on fire" during the spring of 1990 and that the FM recording sounds great. The FM source provides a clear, well‑balanced mix with no reported flaws, making this a highly enjoyable listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Two 5‑star reviews highlight an outstanding performance and high‑quality FM sound; limited number of reviews lowers confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp FM broadcast with clear mix; reviewers report no audio issues.
